limitations: All arms contain AI; effects identify the existing decoder modification only.
Previously inspected Dev; no new confirmatory sample or human-behavior evidence.
Saturated paired OLS equals paired condition means, not an additional discovery.
Repeated conditions are not independent demand observations. Few source families.
Source-deletion ranges are sensitivities, not confidence intervals or causal guarantees.
Censored retail demand is excluded from exact loss only, not from question metrics.
Generated and retail loss definitions remain separate; hold/invalid penalties are retained.

reproduction.limitations: Reproduction of existing Dev analysis; not new model inference or confirmatory data
reproduction.initialAttempt: Staging omitted uv.lock required by provenance; retained the failed attempt, copied the unchanged lock and reran without changing analysis or measurements.

complementary.scope: native component diagnostics, not an end-to-end order benchmark

core-retail-train-v1.scope: Frozen complementary snapshot plus source-disjoint original Train sales; no latent demand or organizational efficacy claim

core-tatqa-train-v1.scope: Frozen complementary snapshot plus original Train financial-document annotations; no organizational efficacy claim

core-retail-holdout-v1.scope: Existing inputs unchanged plus frozen unseen-source evaluation; original public Train split reused only for previously unused sources, not model training

core-retail-linked-v1.scope: Original snapshots unchanged; extra observations within existing Train source families
